newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude dips after brief rally.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude dips after brief rally.

text.p: IPE November Brent crude lost ground after a brief rally to the day's highs, in line with a recovery on NYMEX heating oil, brokers said.
"The heating oil came in low and then started to lead the way up but it's backed off now," one broker said.
November Brent traded down 32 cents on the day at $24.17 a barrel at 1515 GMT, off the high of $24.40.
October gas oil, which expires on Thursday, traded last down $1.25 at $246.00 a tonne. The contract already hit, and failed to break above, resistance at $250 three times.
"It will take a lot to break above that today," one said.
With such a small consolidation on Brent, some brokers were convinced a move upwards would come soon.

"Thirty cents is only background noise compared to the gains we have made recently. We're still poised to keep the upward trend. I see no indication that we are ready for a major drop in the market," another broker said.
The November/December Brent spread narrowed sharply over the day, currently trading around +50 cents.
